summary.text: Jake Teshka is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 7, which he has represented since November 2020, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Oliver Davis as his opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Jake Teshka was born and lives in South Bend, Indiana, and graduated from St. Joseph High School.
He earned a B.A. in political science from St. Joseph's College and an M.P.A. from Indiana University at South Bend.
Teshka took office on November 4, 2020, succeeding Democrat Ross Deal.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Financial Institutions and Insurance Committee and as a member of the Education and Employment, Labor and Pensions committees.
